title: Docs: CSF Next - Adjust custom args example for better type safety
body:
Updated the documentation to include the proper type for CSF Next, so that the footer becomes a known type to the story

Closes #33377 

<!-- If your PR is related to an issue, provide the number(s) above; if it resolves multiple issues, be sure to break them up (e.g. "closes #1000, closes #1001"). -->

**Add missing semicolon for consistency.**

The type definition is missing a trailing semicolon, whereas all other type definitions in this file have them (lines 7, 55, 102, 195, 249).


<details>
<summary>🔎 Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-type PagePropsAndCustomArgs = React.ComponentProps<typeof Page> & { footer?: string }
+type PagePropsAndCustomArgs = React.ComponentProps<typeof Page> & { footer?: string };
```
</details>
